name: Barbell Power Snatch
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, hinge with bent knees and a flat back, and take a wide overhand snatch grip.
Drive through your feet to lift the bar closely past your knees, then extend your hips, knees, and ankles explosively at your hip crease.
Pull under the rising bar into a quarter squat while punching both arms straight overhead to lock the weight out.
Stand tall with the bar balanced over your midfoot, then lower it safely back to the floor.
tips: Keep the bar brushing close to your body throughout the pull instead of swinging it forward.
Lock your elbows crisply overhead as your feet plant into the receiving stance.
